name: Princess Tauriel
source:
Youngest child of the King and Queen of the elves. Like the [url=https://vndb.org/c165570]MC[/url], Tauriel spends most of her time performing diplomatic duties. Unlike other elves, Tauriel is open to dialogue with other races, like the humans. Tauriel was caught by surprise when she found herself attracted to the MC. While names mean nothing to her, she did know the Prince's by reputation.

[In game description]
